title: Prefix length bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with associated quantities $L(M)$, and let $n,T$ be nonnegative integers and $z$ a finite Boolean word. Define the prefix bound to be $3n+2T+|z|(L(M)+3)+2(L(M)+1)+6$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the meaning of the machine-associated quantity L(M).
